features: New 10th source: Server 10 joins the race — a direct-download source (subtitles burned in, single file per episode) that can win 1080p Sub requests. It counts as a direct file, so the "Prefer direct downloads" toggle prefers it over streams at the same quality. Home now reads "10 Sources"

Home now shows 10 Sources: the stats cell that read "3 DDL Sources" now reads the live server count ("10 Sources"), and the chip above it reads "10 servers" — both derived from the server list so they stay truthful as sources are added
